items.prompt: An old, faded school classroom photograph seen as if half remembered: rows of children from behind at wooden desks, a tall window with autumn light, the edges of the image washed out and partly dissolved as though the memory is being rewritten.

alt.ru: Старая выцветшая фотография класса: дети со спины за партами, высокое окно, края снимка расплываются, будто воспоминание переписывается.
alt.en: An old faded classroom photo: children from behind at desks, a tall window, the edges dissolving as if the memory were being rewritten.
alt.pt: Uma velha fotografia desbotada de sala de aula: crianças de costas nas carteiras, uma janela alta, as margens a dissolver-se como uma memória reescrita.
alt.es: Una vieja foto descolorida de un aula: niños de espaldas en los pupitres, una ventana alta, los bordes disolviéndose como un recuerdo reescrito.

items.prompt: A small laboratory conditioning chamber: a white rat crouches motionless, frozen, on a metal grid floor inside a box; a small loudspeaker is mounted on the wall of the box. A researcher's hand rests on a switch outside. Clinical, quiet.

alt.ru: Камера для опытов: белая крыса замерла на металлической решётке, на стенке ящика маленький динамик, снаружи рука исследователя на выключателе.
alt.en: A conditioning chamber: a white rat frozen on a metal grid, a small speaker on the wall of the box, a researcher's hand on a switch outside.
alt.pt: Uma câmara de condicionamento: um rato branco imóvel numa grelha metálica, um pequeno altifalante na parede, a mão de um investigador num interruptor.
alt.es: Una cámara de condicionamiento: una rata blanca inmóvil sobre una rejilla metálica, un pequeño altavoz en la pared, la mano de un investigador en un interruptor.

items.prompt: A 1970s university seminar room in darkness. An audience of students seen from behind watches a grainy projected film of two cars colliding at an intersection; the projector beam cuts through the air above their heads.

alt.ru: Затемнённая аудитория 1970-х: студенты со спины смотрят зернистый фильм о столкновении двух машин, над головами луч проектора.
alt.en: A darkened 1970s lecture room: students from behind watch a grainy film of two cars colliding, a projector beam overhead.
alt.pt: Uma sala de aula dos anos 70 às escuras: estudantes de costas veem um filme granulado de dois carros a colidir, o feixe do projetor por cima.
alt.es: Un aula de los años setenta a oscuras: estudiantes de espaldas ven una película granulada de dos coches chocando, el haz del proyector encima.
